name: RatRunners
summary: Rat Runners is an action packed multiplayer game where players take on the role of clever rats navigating through various environments filled with challenges. Explore open-world areas, avoid traps, and collect useful items while working to outwit other players. With hands-out movement mechanics, you'll need quick reflexes and strategic thinking to survive in this unpredictable world. Whether you're teaming up with friends or going solo, Rat Runners offers an exciting, fast paced experience full of surprises
